versions.changelog:
- Skill-Name im SKILL.md von "abfallkalender-rv" zu "Abfallkalender RV" geändert.
- Sonst keine funktionalen oder inhaltlichen Änderungen.

Initial release of abfallkalender-rv.

- Download waste collection calendars for Landkreis Ravensburg by address.
- Supports ICS (preferred) and PDF formats.
- Implements strict per-address cache (max 7 days old).
- Command-line script interacts with the official Athos website, following all required selection steps.
- Provides clear error messages with suggestions on invalid location or street.
- Output path can be customized; defaults to current directory with server-provided filename.
